subject: maths
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: A metal has density 9 g/cm^3 and volume 20 cm^3. What is its mass?
questions.explain: Mass = density x volume = 9 x 20 = 180 g.

questions.q: A block has mass 240 g and volume 30 cm^3. What is its density?
questions.explain: Density = mass ÷ volume = 240 ÷ 30 = 8 g/cm^3.

questions.q: A car travels 150 km in 2 hours. What is its average speed?
questions.explain: Speed = distance ÷ time = 150 ÷ 2 = 75 km/h.

questions.q: The ratio of red to blue counters is 2 : 7. What fraction are blue?
questions.explain: Total parts = 9, so blue counters are 7/9.

questions.q: It takes 4 builders 6 days to build a wall. How long would it take 3 builders working at the same rate?
questions.explain: Total work = 4 × 6 = 24 builder-days, so 3 builders take 24 ÷ 3 = 8 days.

questions.q: £1 = $1.25. How many dollars do you get for £40?
questions.explain: Multiply by the rate: £40 × 1.25 = $50.

questions.q: y is directly proportional to x, and y = 12 when x = 3. What is y when x = 7?
1 pound = 1.15 euros. How many pounds do you get for 92 euros?
questions.explain: Divide by the rate: 92 / 1.15 = 80 pounds.

questions.q: Simplify the ratio 24 : 36 : 60 to its simplest form.
questions.explain: Divide each part by the highest common factor 12 to get 2 : 3 : 5.

questions.q: Increase £250 by 12%.
Share 35 sweets between Tom and Jo in the ratio 4 : 3. How many does Tom get?
questions.explain: Total parts = 7, each part = 35 / 7 = 5, so Tom gets 4 x 5 = 20.

questions.q: A map has a scale of 1 : 50000. Two towns are 4 cm apart on the map. What is the real distance?
A 6-pack of juice costs 2.40 pounds and a 10-pack costs 3.60 pounds. Which is better value per carton?
questions.explain: 6-pack is 40p each versus 36p each for the 10-pack, so the 10-pack is better value.

questions.q: A 750 g pack of rice costs £1.80 and a 500 g pack costs £1.30. Which is better value per 100 g?
questions.explain: 750 g pack is 24p per 100 g versus 26p per 100 g for the 500 g pack, so the 750 g pack is better value.

questions.q: 5 identical pens cost £3.50. How much do 8 of these pens cost?
questions.explain: One pen costs £3.50 ÷ 5 = £0.70, so 8 pens cost 8 × £0.70 = £5.60.

questions.q: Share £60 between Amy and Ben in the ratio 2 : 3. How much does Ben get?
questions.explain: Total parts = 5, each part = £60 ÷ 5 = £12, so Ben gets 3 × £12 = £36.

questions.q: 2000 pounds is invested at 5% compound interest per year. What is it worth after 2 years?
£500 is invested at 10% compound interest per year. What is it worth after 2 years?
In a class the ratio of girls to boys is 3 : 5. What fraction of the class are girls?
questions.explain: Total parts = 8, so girls make up 3/8 of the class.

questions.q: A recipe for 4 people uses 600 g of flour. How much flour is needed for 6 people?
questions.explain: Per person = 600 / 4 = 150 g, so 6 people need 6 x 150 = 900 g.

questions.q: y is inversely proportional to x, and y = 8 when x = 3. What is y when x = 6?
questions.explain: xy = 24 is constant, so when x = 6, y = 24 / 6 = 4.

questions.q: A cyclist covers 30 km at 12 km/h. How long does the journey take?
questions.explain: Time = distance / speed = 30 / 12 = 2.5 hours.

specSource: Pearson Edexcel GCSE (9–1) Mathematics (1MA1) specification; Ratio Proportion Rates Of Change
